title: Onboarding
about: Consent, a few questions about you, and a 5-question check. About 20 minutes.

title: Kinship words
about: Give your language's words for 150 relatives. About 3 hours, in as many sittings as you like.

title: Resolve disagreements
about: Where the two annotators gave different words, choose the right one.

title: Review questions
about: Check that sample questions read naturally and have the right answer.
